before: Paragraph borders were read only: the editing API had no border members and no operation could add, change, or remove a w:pBdr.
after: Paragraph.borders reads the five edges through the style cascade and writes them through a new local setParagraphBorders operation that replaces the paragraph's own w:pBdr, tracked as a paragraph property revision when change tracking is on.
reason: The new operation applies on the writer's tree and replicates as ordinary node changes inside w:pPr, the same generic w:pBdr nodes released peers already read from documents. No shared field, operation encoding, offset rule, or repair rule changes, and concurrent writes merge under the existing singleton-property rule.
